_comment: All items. CONSUMABLES: effect 'heal' rolls 'dice' as HP; 'cure' removes the condition in 'cures'. GEAR goes on the paper doll (E key) — types map to slots: weapon_<category> and shield -> the two hands ('hands': 2 on a weapon claims both), armor_light/med/heavy -> body, helm -> head, boots -> feet, jewelry_ring -> one of two ring slots, jewelry_neck -> necklace. Weapon categories: light_blade/med_blade/heavy_blade/light_blunt/med_blunt/heavy_blunt/bow (weapons need 'damage', bows also 'range'). ANY worn piece may carry 'ac', 'sp', and/or 'dmg' (+damage on every hit) — they all stack. Class permissions live in classes.json (weapon_types/armor_types/shields); helms, boots, and jewelry fit anyone. 'value' is the gold price for the Phase 4 shops. SUPPLIES: type 'supply' items (rations) are camp fuel, not potions — 'max_carry' caps how many the party can haul. Add items freely! FINESSE (magic-v2 session ruling): 'finesse': true on a weapon lets the wielder aim and damage with the BETTER of STR or DEX — set on light blades. SCROLLS (magic v2): type 'scroll' with 'spell' (an id from spells.json) — a Wizard-lane hero copies it into their spellbook from the character sheet (the scroll is consumed); anyone else can only sell it. RITE TRINKETS: tier-2 Rite rewards; plain worn gear otherwise.
